name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the Mayor
pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may be submitted by email at
publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2023
  6:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Under California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda
only. Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be read and live
comments will be heard at this time.

OUTGOING MAYOR’S PROGRAM

  1. CHECK PRESENTATION FROM LA COUNTY SUPERVISOR JANICE HAHN

  2. PRESENTATION OF CITY TILES
  • LA COUNTY SUPERVISOR JANICE HAHN
  • ABC UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT
  • LA COUNTY FIRE STATION 30

  3. CITY’S PRESENTATION TO OUTGOING MAYOR MONICA MANALO’S YEAR IN
  REVIEW

  4. ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS TO DONORS

  5. COMMENTS FROM OUTGOING MAYOR MONICA MANALO

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
minutes_text:
ARTESIA  CITY COUNCIL  SPECIAL  MEETING  MINUTES
  MONDAY,  DECEMBER  11, 2023, 6:30 P.M.
  ALBERT  O. LITTLE COMMUNITY  CENTER,  18750 CLARKDALE  AVENUE,
  ARTESIA,  CALIFORNIA

CALL  TO ORDER
Mayor  Manalo  called  the meeting  to order  at 6:36 p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present: Mayor Manalo, Mayor Pro Tem Lima, Councilmembers  Taj, Trevino, and Ramoso
Staff Present:  City Manager  Schindler,  Deputy City Manager  Burke, City Clerk Alderete,
Attorney  Nguyen,  Finance Manager  Murguia,  Community Development  Director Dor, Parks
Recreation  Manager  Guerra,  Special  Projects  Manager Lee, Management  Analysts  Tafo
Nacionales,  Laquian, Weichbrodt,  Dean, Fajardo, and Administrative  Secretary  Nieto-Linares

PUBLIC  COMMENTS
Public  comments  could  be provided  for items  listed on the special  agenda,  in person  or submitt
by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us  by 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting. No publa
comments  were provided.

OUTGOING  MAYOR'S  PROGRAM

  1.  L.A. County  Supervisor  Janice  Hahn  presented  a check  to the City.

  2.  Mayor  Manalo  presented  Supervisor  Hahn, ABC  Unified  School  District  Boardmem
  Dr.  Michael  Eugenio,  and  L.A.  County  Fire  Station  30 Acting  Assistant  Fire  Cha
  Jason  Robertson  with a City tile.

  3.  Council  made  a presentation  to Mayor  Manalo.

  4.  Mayor  Manalo  acknowledged  donations  made  by the  City  of Lakewood,  Chamber
  Commerce,  and L.A.  County  Fire  Station  30.

  5.  Mayor  Manalo  provided  comments.

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
Mayor Pro Tem Lima, and Councilmembers  Taj, Trevino,  and Ramoso  provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT
The meeting adjourned  at 7:36 p.m.

Jennifer  Alderete,  City Clerk
